review_context.commercial_perspective: Upgraded from a v1 gold set.
review_context.objective: Pre-signature review before disclosing technical information to a prospective supplier.

comment: CANDIDATE, NOT AUTHORITATIVE. Offsets derived from v1 anchors; severities carried over from a single annotator. Requires blind second annotation and adjudication before replacing expected/*.json.

obligations.label: Definition
obligations.quote: any and all information disclosed by either party

risk.rationale: medium — a definition covering all information whether or not marked confidential is over-broad and lacks the standard public-domain, prior-possession and independent-development carve-outs. It is worse than market but negotiable.

obligations.label: Confidentiality
obligations.quote: shall keep all Confidential Information secret

obligations.label: Term
obligations.quote:
shall
remain in effect in perpetuity

risk.rationale: high — a perpetual confidentiality obligation with no survival period and no trade-secret carve-out is unenforceable in substance and unmanageable in practice; the receiving party cannot ever demonstrate compliance has ended.

obligations.label: Return Destruction
obligations.quote:
return or destroy all
Confidential Information in its possession

obligations.label: Governing Law
obligations.quote:
laws of
the Federal Republic of Germany

obligations.label: Permitted Disclosure
obligations.quote: required by law, court order, or a competent regulatory authority

risk.rationale: high — conditioning a legally compelled disclosure on the disclosing party's prior written consent is not capable of performance. The standard position is notice where lawful and cooperation in seeking protective relief, not consent.

obligations.label: Residual Knowledge
obligations.quote: retained in the unaided memory of its personnel

risk.rationale: high — an unaided-memory residuals clause that permits use for the benefit of third parties defeats the operative obligation in section 2. Whatever a person remembers may be used for a competitor, so the agreement protects only documents, not information.

obligations.label: No License
obligations.quote: grants the Receiving Party any licence or other right

obligations.label: Injunctive Relief
obligations.quote: damages may be an inadequate remedy for breach

obligations.label: Assignment
obligations.quote: including a competitor of the disclosing counterparty

risk.rationale: high — free assignment to a competitor of the disclosing party defeats the purpose of the agreement, since the counterparty can change to the one party the discloser would never have contracted with.

obligations.label: Notices
obligations.quote: effective when sent by email to the address

risk.rationale: low — email-only notice with no read receipt or deemed-delivery rule is slightly off-market and worth a note, not a blocker.
